title: Trace filter correlation (calculate_trace_filter_correlation, trace correlation API): convert experiment IDs to int for trace_info.experiment_id binds; keep str only at the public boundary
answers: Trace correlation or filter-correlation request fails with a psycopg/PostgreSQL type error when experiment_ids are passed on PostgreSQL with psycopg v3
How do I add another filter option to trace filter correlation without breaking the SQL bind on PostgreSQL?
Where are trace filter correlation counts (filter1, filter2, joint, total) computed in the SQL tracking store?
Why does the public experiment_ids string argument get turned into an integer before the trace correlation SQL runs?
body:
Path: Trace filter correlation (the API that returns total, filter1, filter2 and joint trace counts for two filter_strings, with an optional base_filter) enters at mlflow/store/tracking/sqlalchemy_store.py:SqlAlchemyStore.calculate_trace_filter_correlation. It accepts string experiment IDs, resolves them through _filter_experiment_ids, then builds subqueries with _build_trace_filter_subquery and counts them in _get_trace_correlation_counts.
Rule: After _filter_experiment_ids returns, keep the IDs as int (do not re-stringify them). The subquery and count helpers take list[int] and bind against SqlTraceInfo.experiment_id, which is an INTEGER column. Convert to str only at the public API boundary, never before a SQL bind. Any new filter or count added to this path must follow the same rule.
Symptom: On PostgreSQL with the psycopg v3 driver, trace filter correlation failed on the query because a VARCHAR bind was compared with the INTEGER trace_info.experiment_id column. The public API accepted string IDs, so the failure appeared for ordinary calls.
Constraints: Applies to the SQL tracking store only. The fix is about bind types, not filter semantics, so filter strings and base_filter behave as before. A regression test, test_trace_filter_correlation_binds_integer_experiment_ids in tests/db/test_workspace_tracking_store.py, is parametrized with base_filter None and a base tag filter. It runs through the psycopg3_store fixture and checks zero counts on an empty experiment and counts equal to 1 after one matching trace is logged.
applies: SQL tracking store trace correlation and trace search counts when the backend is PostgreSQL with psycopg v3; not the file store or in-memory paths.
says: Trace filter correlation queries fail with a database type error on PostgreSQL backends.
Calculating joint trace counts across multiple filters crashes when specifying experiment identifiers.
Support trace correlation and overlap analysis seamlessly on PostgreSQL tracking database deployments.
Comparing trace filter criteria returns an unexpected database error during ordinary requests.
search: In mlflow/store/tracking/sqlalchemy_store.py:SqlAlchemyStore.calculate_trace_filter_correlation, experiment IDs must remain integers after resolution through _filter_experiment_ids to bind against the INTEGER column in SqlTraceInfo.experiment_id. Subquery and count helpers _build_trace_filter_subquery and _get_trace_correlation_counts require list[int], converting to string only at the public API boundary. This avoids PostgreSQL type mismatch errors with psycopg v3, applies solely to the SQL tracking store, and preserves existing filter semantics.
